What Python can do is emulate the effect of “more memory” by moving state to disk and only keeping small working sets in RAM.

What Python cannot do

Cannot call anything that turns a file into swap (needs mkswap/swapon + privileges).

Cannot exceed memory.max (cgroup limit) by “being clever.”
